text: Distributing validation and execution across many nodes mitigates central point of failure risk and makes the network more resilient to attacks and disruptions, which is the security payoff of decentralization.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
abstract: By distributing the validation and execution processes across numerous nodes, blockchain technology mitigates the risks associated with central points of failure and enhances the resilience of the network against attacks and disruptions.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: decentralized networks where no single node controls the system
